question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**comprehensive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes two types of reality technologies: augmented reality and virtual reality, highlighting the difference between them.
 
• The blank here requires an adjective that describes the nature of the virtual reality environment, specifically one that is fully immersive and detailed.
 
• "Comprehensive" fits perfectly as it implies an all-encompassing, detailed simulation, which aligns with the description of virtual reality in the passage.
 
• Other options like "conclusive", "transgressive", and "reprehensive" do not fit the context of describing a fully immersive virtual environment.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Conclusive"** means bringing something to a conclusion, which does not describe the nature of a virtual environment in the context of the passage.
 
• **"Transgressive" **refers to something that goes beyond acceptable boundaries, which doesn't fit the context of virtual reality as a simulation.
 
• **"Reprehensive"** means deserving of criticism, which is unrelated to describing a virtual environment.
